mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering and then recovering useful substances was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidneys do more than simply remove waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable because the slots named both parts.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the filter lets useful glucose, salts and water through along with wastes, so some must be taken back.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the connections clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following the fluid from filtering through recovery to the bladder made the steps fit together, and I would be curious to see another body system explained that way.
